document: Alone Against the Dark Defying the Triumph of the Ice (A Solo Play Call of Cthulhu Mini Campaign) Chaosium Publication 23154 (Matthew Costello, Mike Mason, Petr Štovik etc.) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

paragraphs.text:
The amulet is a magic item and summons Nodens, an Elder 
God, who will carry you anywhere you wish once, or will supply 
1D10 nightgaunts to obey your orders (but you will still have 
to make a Sanity roll (0/1D6 Sanity points loss) when they 
appear—their sinister faceless faces, pointed claws, and wicked 
barbed tails are the stuff of nightmares!). For more information 
about nightgaunts, see page 302 in the Call of Cthulhu Rulebook. 
The amulet disappears after one use; the nightgaunts fly away 
after one encounter (make a note in your journal). Go to any 
Bremen Location.
(470)
